name: Spiking Labs
description: Spiking Labs builds products for the details that matter in everyday life, made for people, and helps teams put private AI to work without giving up their data.

hero.after: of intelligence for everyday life, made for people.
hero.lead: We build products for the details that matter in daily life, and help teams put private AI to work without handing over their data.

principles.title: Private where it matters
principles.body: Wherever your data is involved, it stays yours. We prefer on-device storage, self-hosted models and no tracking, and we say so in plain words.

principles.title: Close to real life
principles.body: We care about the details that give ordinary days their weight, and build for the moments that bring people closer together.

principles.title: Looked after for the long run
principles.body: We maintain, curate and sustain every tool we build. If we cannot look after it properly, we do not ship it.

cta.title: Got a problem worth solving? Tell us about it.
cta.body: Describe your team and the problem in a few lines. We will get back to you with next steps.
cta.label: Write to us
cta.subject: Let's talk about AI for my business

about.title: A lab that looks after what it builds.
paragraphs: Our team has a diverse background. We have brought automation, data-driven decision making and machine learning to different industries and to companies of different sizes.
We are ready to create value using our knowledge and experience. Just drop us a message.
